camera.board_pose_from: WARNING camera not static; median board pose used anyway

metadata.world_frame: Right-handed, metres. Origin = front-left outer corner of the 5x7 ChArUco pattern lying on the front-left burner (the pattern corner nearest the person and furthest left; OpenCV board point (0, 0.21, 0)). x = along the board's 5-square edge, pointing RIGHT along the counter (toward the knobs and the pan's start spot); y = along the 7-square edge, pointing toward the WALL (away from the person); z = UP, normal to the board/glass plane, z = 0 at the top of the board paper. x_w = x_board, y_w = 0.21 m - y_board, z_w = -z_board. Pan position = centre of the 80 mm marker on the inside bottom of the pan. Orientation = ZYX Euler angles (yaw about world z, then pitch about y, then roll about x) of the marker frame (x, y in the marker plane, z out of its printed face = up when the pan is level). The marker's in-plane rotation relative to the handle is unknown, so yaw is the heading of the marker's x edge: use it as a change, not as the handle direction.

calibration.model: pinhole + radial k1, k2 (no tangential, no k3); OpenCV conventions

phases.definitions: first_disturbance = smoothed pose leaves the start pose by more than the rest threshold (6 sigma of the first 0.5 s, >= 1.5 mm / 0.5 deg), i.e. the hand first moves the pan; the start rest window ends 0.1 s before it. lift_off = last frame before the climb with the marker centre within 3 mm of its start height; touchdown = first frame after the peak with the centre within 3 mm of its end height; settled = first frame after which the pose stays within the end rest threshold (the end rest window starts 0.1 s later). base_clear_est / base_first_contact_est use the lowest point of a base disc of base_radius in the marker plane (the pan pivots on one edge while tilted), threshold 2 mm.
